narrative: The new Lord Mayor's barge with the companies' streamers past a working boatman; at the frame's edge a woman's dark head turned away, laughing

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: In Streamers, and a head turned away

entities.name: Davy Gannet
entities.context: Worked the boat at the near edge of the show.

entities.name: the lady of the parish
entities.context: Turned away, laughing, and was not named.
